name: When Wind Turns Stale
source:
The fog hangs low over a small red farmhouse amidst rolling cornfields. The wind has stagnated, and the crickets and birds have fallen silent. A lone, tall, winged figure stands before you. 

How exactly did you get here?

[From [url=https://inkymoth.itch.io/when-wind-turns-stale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雾气低低地笼罩在连绵起伏的玉米田中的一座红色小农舍上空。风停了，蟋蟀鸟儿也寂静了。一个孤独、高大、长着翅膀的身影站在你面前。

你到底是怎么到这里来的？

[来自[url=https://inkymoth.itch.io/when-wind-turns-stale]Itch.io[/url]]
